tei:div.tei:p: rtse le gong 'og grwa tshang dgon gsum po rnams kyi bstan pa ji ltar btsugs pa'i lo rgyus bzhugs/ 314)swa sti pra dzñā bh+yaḥ gangs can yul 'dir sangs rgyas bstan pa ni// dang po kho nar byung ba'i 'byung khungs mchog /snga 'gyur rig 'dzin grub thob tshar dngar ba// brgyud par bcas zhabs gus pas btud bya'o/ 'dir sprul pa'i skyes mchog mi pham chos kyi spyan ldan gang gis bka' yig chos kyi 'bel gtam rim par gnang ba'i skabs re shig la/ bdag cag rtse le gong 'og rnams kyi bstan pa'i babs tshul ji ltar yin gyi dri mol bstsal ba'i lan du 'phros pa 'ga' zhig phul ba rnams/ rang phyogs kyi grwa gzhon rang rgyus rang la med pa dag la 315)phan par dgongs te dpe thog tu 'bebs pa gnang 'dug pa ni 'di dag yin te/ de yang gter ston rin po che gu ru chos kyi dbang phyug gi dngos slob rgyal sras sman lung pa chen po'i slob brgyud mang yang*/ dwags phyogs su byon pa la/ sangs rgyas dwags ston pa de nas rim pas gnyan ston badz+ra dzñā na/ se sdings pa gu ṇa pha la/ bya ra mkhan po g.yu thul ba chos sku 'od zer rnams rim brgyud zhi khro bka' rgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs kyi grub thob sha stag tu byon zhing*/ bla ma chos sku 'od zer de nyid kyis rtse le rnying ma'i dgon sde btab nas dar rgyas cher byung yang*/ phyis 316)bskal dus kyi ser khyim par gyur nas zhig ral cher byung rjes/ sngon tshe bsam yas lo paṇa bzhugs pa'i khrod du mchims ston shākya pra bha wa zhes pa slob dpon pad+ma gdan drangs pa'i pho nya mdzad cing*/ phyis slob dpon la rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor zhus nas nyams su blangs pas grub pa thob pa dang*/ de'i skye ba grwa sgom shes rab bzang po rmi lam sgyu lus 'od gsal la mnga' brnyes pa dang*/ mdo khams gter ston shes rab me 'bar du 'khrungs pa sogs dag pa'i skye ba bco lnga brgyud pa'i tha mar rig 'dzin chen po bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba zhes pa de nyid sku rabs gong ma byang chub bzang po'i sras su 'khrungs pa'i sku mched gnyis kyi che ba gong ma rin chen dbang rgyal bas rgyal srid bskyangs shing*/

sku gzhon pa bsod nams rnam par rgyal ba 'dis khrims khang lo chen bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde'i spyan sngar rab byung bzhes te mdo sngags rig gnas sogs shes bya'i gnas thams cad la sbyangs pa mthar 317)son par mdzad/ rje mi skyod zhabs/ zhwa dmar spyan snga chos grags/ dpal gtsug lag 'phreng ba rdor 'dzin bstan pa rgya mtsho sogs mkhas grub kyi bla ma bcu phrag mang po bsten nas/ gsar rnying bka' gter gyi chos thams cad la dbang 'byor ba de nyid kyis gcen po dang yum sogs bka' gros mthun par rtse le gsar ma 'di nyid btab nas/ o rgyan gyi gser sku rgyab mtho nyer brgyad pas thog drangs gtsug lag rten gsum grangs med pa bzhengs shing*/ dge 'dun bdun cu tsam la 'du ba'i sgo gya nom pa dang bcas pa sbyar/ lha chen gyi rab gnas mdzad por rig 'dzin mgon po spyan drangs pa dang*/ gzhan yang*/ rgyal sras zla ba grags pa/ rab 'byams dge ba'i blo gros/ rdzogs chen bsod nams rin chen/ gter gton las 'phro gling pa/ sgam po pa nam mkha' gu ru/ dza yig chos rje tshul khrims 318)rgyal mtshan sogs skyes chen dam pa rab tu mang po rtse ler gdan drangs nas chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad par bskor bar mdzad la/ de dag gi skabs su skyes chen grub thob mang po gsung mthun par/ khyed gu ru chos dbang gi sprul pa zhig yin par snang bas/ cha lugs sngags chas dang rigs ldan gyi phyag rgya bzhes nas sras 'gro don nus pa 'ga' yang 'byung la/ rab 'byung 'di ka mdzad na sku tshe dang 'gro don mthar mi phyin par 'gyur bas na/ cis kyang sngags chas mdzod ces nan du bka' bstsal zhing*/ mnal lam nyams snang sogs su'ang gu ru rin po mkha' 'gror bcas pas brda thabs du ma'i sgo nas de ltar byung rung*/ skye 'gro phal gyis sdig pa gsog rkyen du 'gyur dogs la dgongs te rab byung mdzad mus la bzhugs pas sku la klu nad kyi bsnyun drag po dang*/

mnal lam sogs su yang rten 'brel chugs pa'i ltas 'ba' zhig 319)byung ba nas sku gshegs la nye ba tsam du 'gyur mthus slar sngags chas dang dbu skra lcang lo sogs mdzad cing phyag rgya bzhes pas bsnyun kyang gzhi med du dengs pa dang rten 'brel thams cad sor chud pa byung*/ sras bskrun pa'i cho gar o rgyan dang rigs gsum mgon po sgrol ma rnams bstim pa'i rten 'brel mdzad pa'i mthu las/ sras che ba dpal o rgyan { o rgyan bstims pas/ } bstan 'dzin/ de 'og karma mthu stobs { phyag rdor/ } rnam rgyal/ de 'og dkar chen pa kun dga' { spyan ras gzigs }bstan 'dzin/ de 'og chos rje mkhan chen { 'jam dbyangs/ } nā len+d+ra pa/ sras mo rje btsun ma dkon mchog { sgrol ma/ } 'tsho mo rnams byon pa so sor lha de dag dang tshul mthun pa'i phrin las kyis gzhan don mdzad pa sha stag byung*/ de ltar rig 'dzin chen po de nyid 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum bya ba las kyi 'khor lo 320)dang bcas pa mtha' dag gi sgo nas bstan 'gro'i don mthar phyin te dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin la bstan pa gtad nas mya ngan las 'das so// dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin dam pa chos kyi sgron me de nyid la rdzogs chen kun 'dus rgya mtsho'i lung byang las 'di ltar bsngags te/ da lta'i mkhas grub g.yu sgra snying po 'di// skye ba nyer lngar bstan pa'i srog shing byed// nyer lnga'i mtha' mar dwags po gru zhes par// grub thob sog po mig ring bu ru skyes// bstan pa'i srol 'dzin mi lo nyis brgyar 'phel// skye ba 'phos nas paṇa chen drung du bde/ zhes rig 'dzin chen po de nyid kyi zhal dbyibs sog po'am a tsa ra lta bu yod pa'i sras su 'khrungs pa dang*/ grwa tshang 'di sogs bstan pa'i srol btsugs pa lo nyis brgyar 'phel ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das rjes rgya nag ri 321)bo rtse lngar paṇa chen bi ma la'i drung du gshegs par 'gyur bar lung bstan pa ste/

de lta bu'i skyes chen de nyid sku mtshan dpe tshang bar bltams shing*/ dge ba'i bshes kyi mtshan nyid dang mthun pa'i bag chags 'ba' zhig ma gtogs 'jig rten gyi dri ma gtan mi mnga' ba nas/ rje gtsug lag 'phreng ba las bslab pa gsum ldan du bsgrubs/ yab kyis bla ma mkhas grub skyes chen mtha' dag spyan drangs nas chos 'khor rgyun mi chad pa'i sku drin gyis/ phyogs gzhan du byon ma dgos par rig pa'i gnas che chung bcu dang*/ mdo rgyud man ngag gsar rnying bka' gter kun gyi dbang lung khrid dang man ngag phyag bzhes snyan brgyud ma lus pa'i mdzod du gyur nas/ rtse le dang sku rab dgon gsar gnyis ka'i mkhan po mdzad/ sku tshe dgung lo so brgyad las ma bzhugs 322)rung rnam dkar gyi mdzad pa rgya che ste/ gsan sbyong dang thugs dam mdzad pa dang*/ bshad sgrub smin grol gyi sgo nas slob ma bskyangs pa dang*/ sku gzugs rten bzhengs pa dang*/ bstan bcos brtsam pa dang*/ rtsis kyi sa ris mdzad pa dang*/ thang sku/ phyag dpe/ dbang rdzas sgrub rdzas sogs kyi phyag bzo mdzad pa kho na yang bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig gnang grub 'dug pa dag da lta rtse le gong 'og na mjal rgyu snang zhing*/ sku skye ba de'i snga ma ni 'khrul zhig sangs rgyas bsam 'grub yin pa'i bag chags kyi/ gnas chen tsā rir yang zhabs tog rgya cher bsgrub par mdzad cing khong rnams kyis kyang rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin to/ de lta bu'i dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin pa de nyid dgung lo so bdun pa la grwa tshang 'di 'dzugs par dgongs nas/ de skabs phyogs dus kyi slob ma mang du yod pa'i khrod nas thugs dam gyi brtag pa dang sbyar ba'i dwags 323)long kong gsum gyi dbon chos mdzad kyi rigs mi brgyad la sprel zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin sku drung du shog gsungs nas/ bdag gi rten 'brel babs tshul zhig la bstun pas de ring khyed rnams la gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos sde zhig 'dzugs pa'i rten 'brel bsgrig pa yin pas/

dge slong mkhyen rab rnam rgyal bas bla ma gyis/ dbon po ri steng ba bstan 'dzin rdo rjes dbu mdzad gyis/ long po ba shes rab 'byung gnas kyis chos khrims gyis gsungs shing gsol ras gnang sbyin dang me tog 'thor nas/ 'o skol rnying ma 'di la rig 'dzin grub thob gter ston mang du byon zhing chos zab khyad rmad du byung ba yod kyang*/ gang zag rnams spyod pa rtsing bas dge 'dun gyi sde shin tu dkon par 'dug pas na/ khyed rnams kyis da nas bzung ste bstan pa'i zhabs tog kho na la bsam pas/ spyod pa 'dul ba/ nyams 324)len bskyed rdzogs/ lta sgom rdzogs chen rnams dang mthun pa'i sgo nas gsang sngags rnying ma'i rkang zin par gyis shig de yang slob gnyer gyi gzhung klong chen pa'i mdzod bdun skor la gyis/ bstan pa yongs rdzogs su 'gyur ba yin/ dkyil chog bka' brgyad dgongs 'dus gnyis la gyis/ gter chos thams cad kyi gtso bo yin/ nyams len snying tig ya bzhi la gyis/ theg pa mtha' dag gi yang bcud yin no/ zhes sogs kyi zhal gdams mthar thug pa gnang*/ bka' srung rta mgrin nag po dregs pa sde brgyad/ btsan rgod 'bar ma mched bdun/ zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu rnams la grwa tshang gi gnyer gtad nan tan mdzad/ khyad par zhing skyong de nyid kyi dngos su zhal gzigs pa'i srung ma yin phyir lhag par gnyan zhing 'go bar yod do/ grwa tshang 'dzugs pa'i dus der rje de'i bka' las/ grub mtha' chos rgyud thams cad zhwa'i 325)rten 'brel gnad du che bar snang bas 'o skol la zhwa'i rten 'brel gang babs brtag dgos gsungs te/ dkon mchog gi spyan sngar mchod pa bshams zhing zhwa rigs thams cad las gang bka' babs pa brtag ril mdzad pa na/ gra zhwa ser po btsod kyis kha ba'i ngur smrig nyid la babs pas rten 'brel bzang*/ mdo sngags zung 'jug gi brdar 'dug gsungs nas zhwa ngur smrig sha stag tu mdzad do/

de ltar dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin nyid sku tshe'i gdul bya re shig rdzogs par gzigs nas/ rtse le'i gdan sar rje mthu stobs rnam rgyal mnga' gsol zhing*/ nyid yang stod karma lha khang du dpal gtsug lag 'phreng ba'i bzhugs sgar du sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu la dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim ste sku gdung ring srel gyi phung por gyur pas skye 'gro dag snang la bkod/ ༈ rje karma mthu stobs 326)rnam rgyal de nyid sku gzhon pa'i dus na thugs spyod shin tu 'tshub pa la/ dgung lo bco brgyad par gtsug lag 'phreng ba'i zhabs pad bsten pa nas mnal sad pa lta bu thugs bsam brnyed de/ mdo sngags rig gnas sogs kyi sgro 'dogs chod nas bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi mkhas grub tu gyur/ ༈ de'i sku mched 'og ma chos rje kun dga' bstan 'dzin pa ni rten dge bsnyen du zhugs shing*/ o rgyan bstan 'dzin pa'i zhabs la btugs pas spyir sku yon phun sum tshogs pa dang khyad par zhi khro bka' brgyad kyi bdag por gyur nas/ dbang sgrub chen sogs kyi sgo nas snod ldan smin grol la bkod cing sems dgon gyi gdan sar bzhugs pas sku mdun sems dgon pa chen por grags/ ༈ sku mched de'i 'og mas sku gzhon nu nas phan yul nā len+d+ra ru gsan sbyong la phebs nas/ dbu tshad phar phyin 'dul mngon sogs mdo phyogs kyi gsan pa phul du phyin nas 327)nā len+d+ra'i mkhan po yun ring du mdzad cing*/ phyis rtse ler sku mched gong ma rnams zhi bar gshegs shul du chos kyi khrir 'khod nas bstan pa'i bya ma mang du mdzad do/ ༈ lcam mo rje btsun ma dkon mchog mtsho mo ni rje mi skyod zhabs las bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong ma'i dngos por gyur te 'dul ba'i bcas pa phra zhing phra ba mtha' dag dri bral du spyod bzhin pas/ zhong kha dgon du btsun ma brgya lhag pa'i dbus na chos ston cing sku tshe dang sgrub pa mthar phyin pas/

dwags lung pa kun gyi phyag mchod kyi gnas su gyur pa byung ngo*/ de nas yang gong gi 'phro las/ dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin pa zhi bar gshegs phral nas rtse le'i gzhis pa rnams kyi rje mthu stobs pa'i snyan du/ nged rang rtse le ba dgon pa gcig gi nang du grwa tshang khag gnyis su byed pa 'di 'gab yul kyang mi 'dug 328)la/ phugs su bstan pa'i sel du'ang 'gro nyen che bas/ grwa tshang gsar pa 'di tshur sdongs pa'am/ de mi byed na khong rang rnams gzhan du rdzong ba lta bu na legs pa 'dra zhes yang yang zhus pa la gsan nas/ grwa tshang gsar pa bzang phud kyi rnam pas 'gro dgos pa shar tshe dge 'dun zhal grangs kun dril nyi shu rtsa bzhi yod pa la dwags po'i grwa rgyun phal chair phar 'jags nas 'gro mkhan kong long gnyis sdebs pa bcu drug las ma byung ba rnams/ rje bde bar gshegs pa de nyid kyis spyi rdzas su gnang ba'i chas phran bu gang yod rnams 'bog dril du 'khur nas thon te/ rim pas kong phyogs su 'ongs pa'i lam zhor du 'o shod gad pa skya bor sangs rgyas gling pa'i gdung rgyud sku mdun karma bzang po'i drung du phur sgrub thugs snying sogs dbang chos 'ga' zhig zhus/ de nas mar la 'ongs nas/ rje gtsug lag 'phreng ba dpon 329)slob rnams gsum mkhar ram thang spang la bzhugs sgar gnang ba'i drung du sleb pa na/ sngar nas bla ma na rim ltar rje rang gi zhal slob yin pa'i 'brel la dgongs nas sgar gyi phyag phyir khrid cing lugs gnyis ka nas bka' drin brtse skyong du mdzad/ der bsdad pa'i zhor la chos sde'i bca' khrims dang rnam dpyod kyi spyan ltos 'don chos spyod rnams kyi gdangs dbyangs sogs gang sar phan skyed che bar byung zhing bka' chos kyang mang bar thob/ slar bzhugs sgar rnam thos tshal du gnang ba'i skabs shig tu/ grwa tshang 'di'i bla ma mkhyen rab rnam rgyal zhes pa/ 'khrungs yul long po bde chen dgon du 'khrungs shing dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin de nyid long po chos 'khor gling du bka' brgyad sgrub chen gnang bar phebs pa'i tshe zhabs la btugs pa nas bzung ste phyag phyir drung yig gtor shom pa dbang g.yog sogs mdzad pa'i bshes gnyen byang

330)chub sems dpa' dngos su bzhugs bzhin par grwa tshang 'di 'dzu+ugs dus bla mar bko bzhag gnang ba de nyid rnam thos tshal du sku gshegs pa la brten grwa tshang ba rnams yid pham zhing sgyid lug ste/ 'o skol rnams rtse ler ma chags par byes su 'khyams pa'i khar bla ma sku gshegs/ dgon gzhis sogs brten sa ni gang yang med tshe da ni spyi chas phran tshegs rnams rje 'di'i drung du phul/ nged rang rnams ci bder spyod pa las 'os med ces gros thag bcad nas rje'i drung du de bzhin zhus pa na bka' las/ spyir skye shi 'pho 'gyur skyid sdug phran bu su la'ang 'ong ba chos nyid yin mod kyang*/ chos rje o rgyan bstan 'dzin pa de nyid skyes chen rtsod med yin pa khong gi grwa tshang btsugs nas khyed tshos thar na dam tshig gi ltung ba yang phog cing lar mi 'thus pas/ khyed rnams ma thar ba zhig gyis dang*/ bdag gis kyang ci nus kyi rogs ram bdag rkyen byed pa yin/ 331)bla ma bsko bzhag kyang bdag tsho'i 'di nas bka' rab 'byams dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji ltar bzang ba zhig bkos rung chos lugs mi gcig tshe khyed tshor phan thogs pa dka'/ gong dkar rdo rje gdan pa'i bca' yig tu phyi'i mkhas btsun las nang gi rgas mgo zhig gis bla ma byed pa dga' ba yin/ phugs chos rgyud mi 'chugs pa'i dgos pa yod/ gsungs snang ba shin tu bden par 'dug des na dbon po ri steng pa khyed rgas mgor 'dug pas bla ma gyis/ khyed gzhan tshos khong gi ci gsung gi bka' bsgrubs dang*/ bstan pa mgo thon pa 'ong bar 'dug gsungs nas/ mnga' bdag myang gi gter ma gu ru rin po che'i zhabs rjes khyad 'phags kyis thog drangs pa'i bla chas gur chas rta bzhi dang bcas pa'i bsko 'dza' gnang zhing me tog thor/ lha ba gzhung gi rgyab bdag dpon khag bzhi po yon 332)bdag tu sbyar zhing*/ khyad par lha ba phu'i dpon bsam 'phel don grub la gnang sbyin dang bka' lung gi zhib gnyer mdzad do/

༈ de ltar bskau bzhag gnang ba'i mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rje dpal bzang po nyid kyi lo rgyus rags bsdus brjod na/ skye rgyud sogs ni kho bo cag gi skyes rabs gsol 'debs dag las 'byung phyir 'dir yig tshogs la 'dzem nas ma bkod la/ sku 'khrungs pa'i gnas ni dwags kong gnyis kyi so mtshams nga la ri steng gi gnas su te/ gnas de ni sngon slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer zhig spros nas yar lung sham po'i gnas su grub thob sangs rgyas sgom pa zhes bya ba 'byung ba lnga la rang dbang thob pa'i skyes bu dam pa zhig tu sprul nas sham po'i gangs la sgrub pa mdzad cing bzhugs pa'i drung na khye'u lo brgyad pa dar dkar gyis gos gyon pa gcig byung nas/ khyod 'di ru ma 333)'dug shar du song*// shar kong po shing rong drag po'i sa// brag ri dar dkar sbrel 'dra'i drung*// gnas kyi lte ba chos 'byung dbyibs// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i pho brang yod// de ru song la sgrub pa gyis// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan yod/ ces zer nas mi snang bar gyur pas/ de ma thag rdzu 'phrul gyis 'phur nas byon te mchims yul nga la'i rtser babs cing*/ mchims lha spun dgu dang nga la brag btsan dam la btags nas gnas kyi lte bar sgrub khang btab nas bzhugs/ grub thob sangs rgyas sgom pa'i sras mtshungs med blo gros rgyal mtshan zhes/ gter ston pad+ma las 'brel stsal gyi gter kha'i chos bdag tu lung gi zin cing 'gro don yang rgya cher byung*/ de'i sras chos rje byang chub rin chen/ de sras byang sems rig 'dzin rgya mtsho/ de la sras chos rje 'jam dbyangs pa dang sku mdun rgya mtsho ba 334)gnyis byung zhing gdan sa lhan cig tu bzung*/ jo mo gnyis yod pa'i jo mo gser khang ba la sras chos rje 'phags pa dang don grub rab gsal gnyis 'khrungs/ jo mo 'khar kha ba la bla ma dbang phyug rgya mtsho dang dge slong dpal 'byor ba gnyis byung zhing*/

chos rje 'phags pa la sras gsum byung yang thams cad sku gzhon nu la 'das/ dbang phyug rgya mtsho'i sras gsum gyi che ba ni ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba ste/ rig 'dzin rat+na gling pa'i sras tshe dbang grags pa'i bu chen du gyur cing*/ 'dis gdan sa bzung ba'i sras ni bla ma ngag dbang grags pa yin la/ de las bla ma tshe brtan dang*/ dpon slob karma bkra shis/ dbon po rgyal dbang*/ grub chen rnam 'phrul ba sogs sras brgyad/ sras mo gnyis dang bcu tsam byung ba 'di rnams yin no/ ngag dbang chos rgyal gyi sku mched bar pa de ni sku gzhon nu nas 'bri gung rin chen phun tshogs kyi zhabs la btugs nas 335)thugs dam mngon du gyur pas/ mon gnas kyi mtsho phu gangs rar sku tshe sgrub pa la bskyal zhing 'das tshe sku gdung ring srel gyi gong bur gyur pa byung*/ sku mched chung ba ni mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rje nyid yin la/ lcam mo gnyis kyi bgres pa ni kong stod rta sdings kyi ri khrod du bzhugs shing sku mdun dbon mor grags pas chos kyi 'gro don che bar byung ba dang*/ lcam chung shos ni mtshungs med de nyid zhabs la btugs nas gtsang po 'go dgu'i rgyab kyi mtsho rgyal phug par tshe dang sgrub pa mnyam pa byung*/ mtshungs med de nyid dgung lo bcu gnyis nas dwags po sku rab dgon gsar gyi chos grwar bzhugs nas mtshan nyid kyi gsan sbyong shin tu dmar ba yod skabs sku la sa gdon gyi bsnyun gzhi'i rnam pa phra mo byung ba'i rkyen gyis bskul te/ rtse le rig 'dzin chen po de 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i grub thob klu dang sa bdag gi gnyen po yin pa'i 336)snyan gsan nas dgung lo bca bdun la rtse ler byon zhing*/ nā ga rak+sha'i dbang lung sgrub thabs sogs zhus nas bsnyen sgrub mdzad pas bsnyun rtsa ba nas thon/ der sngon gyi smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar bas dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin pa'i drung du so so thar pa'i sdom pa nas bzung ste rdzogs pa chen po'i bar gyi smin grol gdams pa'i bdud rtsis thugs kyi bum bzang yongs su gang bar thob cing*/

lo bcu gnyis bla ma'i spyan sngar bzhugs ring zhabs togs su chibs kha ba nas bzung ste gsol gzims dpon/ mgron gnyer/ dung rgya gling pa/ spos 'dzin pa/ dbang g.yog dbu mdzad kyi bar du las sna bka' gang gnang mtha' dag bsgrubs pas mnyes pa mthar son/ dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin sku mya ngan las 'das rjes grwa tshang kong phyogs su thog mar sleb dus rten gzhi med pas 'tsho ba bsod snyoms dang chos 'don la brten dus 337)su/ grwa tshang rang gi grwa pa'i nang nas phrag yul ri steng pa'i dbon po o rgyan rin chen dang*/ gsum mkhar nas mon gnas kyi zhal ngo bla ma bstan 'dzin pa gnyis po 'khrungs sa dang 'byor pa che bas lo gnyis kyi bar du grwa tshang gi bstan pa bka' drin che bar byung zhing*/ slar yang rje gtsug lag 'phreng ba'i zhabs phyir yod mus la bla ma mkhyen rab pa 'das pas mtshungs med de nyid la bsko bzhag gnang nas yon bdag sbyar ba'i mthus/ mtshungs med nyid kyi dgung lo so gcig pa'i thog tu dpon bsam 'phel don grub kyis gdan drangs te thang 'brog gi dgon gzhis phyi nang tshang mar phul ba yin no/ thang 'brog 'od gsal rtse 'di dang por pha dam pa'i rnam par 'phrul pa skyes mchog chos rje bsam gtan dpal gyi slob ma zhig gis btabs nas/ sgom chen pa phyed nyis brgya tsam rtag tu bzhugs shing 338)bla ma bsko bzhag kyang phan yul sgo mo chos sdings nas gnang ba'i rgyun phyi mo'i bar du byung ba'i bsko 'ja' la gnang ba'i sku 'dra rdor dril sogs da lta yang grwa tshang du yod la/ phyis shig na phyugs rdzis ri me shor ba mched nas dgon pa rjes med du tshig ste stongs/ slad du chos rje gong chen pa nam mkha' chos kyi rgya mtsho sku mched kyis zhig gso dang bdag rkyen gnang nas nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i gcung po drung pa blo gros seng ges gdan sa bzung zhing gsar rnying gnyis ka'i grwa slob mang du 'dus pa rnams la dbang skor phreng dang sgrub thabs brgya rtsa sogs dang*/

phyag rdzogs kyi khrid rims mang po dbyar chos dgun chos sgrigs chags kyi srol mdzad do/ ri logs gong 'og g.yas g.yon kun tu dgon chung dang ri khrod pa mang po yod pa rnams la 'od gsal rtse nas chos dung btang tshe so so nas 'dus yong ba sogs chos srol bzang bar 339)yod pa'i brgyun bzhin mkhas grub blo seng ba sku gshegs nas kyang zhal slob rin po che chos ldan pa/ drung pa rdo rje 'chang du grags pa rnams kyi ring la'ang yod kyang*/ phyis cung zhig rgud pa'i skabs su rtse le grwa tshang 'di phebs pa ste/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rje'i dgung lo so gsum pa shing mo glang lor thang 'brog gzhis kha'i bla brang rmang bting zhing*/ de dgong du gdan sa dngos gzhi thang 'brog rang dang*/ gzhis kha ni lam stegs kyi tshul lta bu yin na'ang*/ grwa tshang bzhugs sa gong ma cung zhig sa khad mtho drag par dgongs nas 'og mar gzhis phabs/ de skabs grwa tshang phyogs nas gsar sleb lta bur gyur zhing 'dris med bshes med kyi dbang gis dad zas gdul bya sogs cher med pas 'tsho ba dang phyag rdzas bkren pa dang*/ khang las gsar rgyag rdzogs lji ba sogs kyi phyi nang tshang mas grwa tshang mgo thon zhig mi 'ong bar gleng 340)zhing mtshungs med nyid kyang thugs khral che ba la/ mnal lam du bud med bzang mo kong chas can zhig gi lag tu mda' dar dmar po zhig 'dug pa phyag tu phul nas/ khyed thugs mi bde ba mdzad mi 'tshal/ phrin las gang dgos nged kyis bsgrub pa yin no/ zhes kong btsun de mos yang yang khas len pa byung rung*/ mtshungs med de nyid 'di 'dra'i rigs la bden 'dzin dang mnyes tshor lar mi mdzad pas btang snyoms 'ba' shig tu bskyur na'ang phrin las bsgrub pa'i rtags mtshan ni rgyun du mchis so/ glang lo'i mjug der rtse le nas zhabs drung karma mthu stobs rnam rgyal sku rab sde sa dang cung zhig thugs ma mthun pa'i rkyen la brten nas kong phyogs su grwa tshang la zhal gtad nas byon byung bar mtshungs med pas/

khyed gzhis ka dpon slob rnams kyis bdag cag grwa tshang gsar pa la sku drin bskyangs po de mdzad ma byung rung*/ da char 341)chos rje nyid ngos kyis phebs pa la phyag phyi zhabs tog ci nus bsgrub dgos pa ni gzhir bcas la/ 'on kyang khyed chos rje chen po zhig nged kong po'i grwa tshang chung ngu bsod snyoms dang grong chog chos 'don gyi lto 'tshol dgos pa'i dkyil du bzhugs pa babs thob mi 'ong bas/ re shig khams phyogs su phebs pa 'thad pas na/ bdag tsho la 'khos khyer ci yang med kyang de lugs kyi rdzongs star grab yul byed pa lags zhus shing*/ de lo'i sgrub mchod thog tu dpon slob lhan cig pas thang 'brog tu bka' brgyad kyi sgrub chen sman dang 'brel ba'i dbang mo che mdzad pas gdul bya thams cad ngo mtshar yid ches la bkod/ de rjes mi ring bar rje mthu stobs pa dpon slob nyi shu rtsa lnga sgar chas rta drel sogs gra bsgrigs nas byon te/ dar rtse mdo yan gyi yul khams phal mo chos kyi 'gro don dang zang zing gi dad 342)'bul kyang rgya cher byung zhing*/ khyad par de skabs ri bo cher chos rje pad+ma rgyal pos gdan sa mdzad skabs yin tshe/ zla phyed tsam gyi bar du nyin re bzhin ja gral gyi zhal 'phros su mdo sngags dang rig gnas bka' gsar snying sogs sgo du ma nas chos rje nyid dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mang pos re mos kyis dri ba gnang ba la/ rje mthu stobs pas skabs tha dad kyi lan zhib rgyas gtan tshigs lung rgyab dang 'brel bar phul bas thugs yid ches te/ nyin re bzhin du chos rje nyid kyi bzhugs khri rim pas 'phri zhing*/ rje mthu stobs pa'i bzhugs gdan spar te/ mthar chos rje nyid stan kyang gcig dang*/ mthu stobs pa khri thog tu bzhugs su gsol zhing bka' gsar snying gi chos bka' mang du gsan par mdzad/ 'byon bar gnang sbyin la yang*/ gu ru rin po che'i phyag mtshan rdor dril khyad 'phags stag lung sangs rgyas dbon gyis gtsang gi brag rgya'o dgu 'dus

343) nas gter nas gdan drangs pa dang*/ thugs rje chen po sems nyid ngal gso'i zhal thang hor si mu tig gi rgyan can 'bri gung skyob pa'i thugs dam rten dang*/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhal thang thags grub ma gra tshar rgya sgam tshag ma dang bcas pa/ rgya nag thugs dam ma'i gser sku tshe dpag med 'jam dbyangs sgrol ma gsum rgya shubs cha 'grig gtso 'khor dang*/ hor sbub chen mo nyi ma 'brug grags zhes rtsod med sogs khyad 'phags kyi rigs mtha' yas pa'i gnang cha mdzad/ de ltar rje mthu stobs pas mdo khams su lo lnga bzhugs nas rta drel bdun cu rtsa grangs rgyab non bcas te yar phebs pas phyag rdzas rten mchod khyad par can rnams phal cher gra tshang dang*/ 'ga' zhig rtse le gong mar gnang zhing*/ gzhan dngos po tshang ma chud zos med par mtshungs med de nyid kyis phyag mdzod pa'i tshul mdzad de dpon slob lhan rgyas 344)su phebs nas gtso bor dpal bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang thams cad la zhig gsos mchod 'bul gser gsol sogs bla na med pa mdzad cing*/ dus dbang gi lha khang so so'i rten bshad sogs rgyun chad pa dgongs nas gtsug lag khang tha dad kyi lo rgyus bzhugs byang dkar chag shog dril phyag bris gnang nas lha khang so so'i ka gdong la sbyar ba sogs zhabs tog phul du phyin pa mdzad pas/ de dus kyi snyan dar phul ba'i gos yug dang gan dar yug ring sogs la smon lam phyag bris zhal yig can mang po 'dug pa phyis bdag gis kyang mthong zhing*/ gzhan yang lha sa khra 'brug sogs mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gtsug lag rten gsum dang*/ yul gru tha dad kyi jo bo rang byon gyi rigs sogs mtha' dag par skabs su gang babs kyi mchod rdzas bzhugs khri rgyab yol snyan dar gser chab la sogs te/ mdor na bstan pa spyi'i lha khang gi 345) rigs la zhabs tog mdzad lugs de dus las lhag pa ni bla chen gang gis kyang ma mdzad pa lta bur snang ste/

gzhan phal cher ni rang rang gi gdan sa dang lha khang sogs la spungs mod la/ 'di skabs ni phyogs med kyi gtsug lag la mchod par mdzad pas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba nyid do/ de ltar rje mthu stobs pa de nyid kyis dus phyis kyang thub pa'i mdzad brgya zhing bkod kyi zhal thang sangs rgyas stong re re la'ang gtso 'khor tshom bu yongs rdzogs kyi gser thang bcu bdun gyi grangs ldan ngo mtshar can dang*/ gu ru mtshan brgyad kyi gra thang sogs sku rten grangs med dang*/ bstan bcos rin po che mdzod bdun gyi glegs bam sogs phyag dpe mtha' yas pa bzhengs pa dang*/ tshig don rin po che'i mdzod par du bsgrub pa la sogs mdzad pa thams cad kyang khe grags kyi slad du mdzad lo tsam ma yin par gzhan las spus 346)gtsang ba/ dag cha thon pa/ dper 'os pa sha stag mdzad par gda' la/ gzhi byes lam gsum thams cad du yang thugs dam sgrigs la/ bskang gso gtor chog dus bzang gi mchod pa sogs kyang thugs rtsol gzhan las lhag pa thugs brel sogs gang gis kyang bar mi chod pa dang*/ grub mtha' chos rgyud gang dang ci lta bus bka' chos zhus na'ang de nyid dang mthun pa'i chos zab cing rgya che ba bstsal bas yid kyi re ba skongs nus la/ thos pas rgyags shing dregs pa'i khengs ldan dag dang por ma gus pas co 'dri dang tshod lta'i phyir zhabs drung du snyegs te de dang mtshungs pa'i gtam brjod pa dag kyang rje 'dis tshangs pa'i dbyangs dang chos kyi spobs pa so so yang dag rigs pa'i gzi byin gyis non te/ khengs pa'i me spungs zhi nas dad pa'i spul long g.yo ba sha stag 'byung zhing*/ gzhan yang*/ dngos nyams dag snang gi gzigs par ye 347)shes lha'i snang ba rab 'byams mnga' ba dang*/ spu bo'i yul du skye bo rtsal can zhig 'byung pos brlams te mi mang pos rub nas bzung kyang ma thub pa la bgegs skrad zhus pas/ thugs 'ur ba'i tshul gyis brang la zhabs tho zhig brgyab pas gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i steng du bka' srung gi gtor ma phyag gis 'phangs pa na gdon can de ngu 'bod drag po 'don zhing phyin chad gnod pa gtan bral du yong ba dang*/

mi nyag zan gyi phur klu mo dkar mo zhig dam la btags nas chu mig bton pa sogs grub pa'i spyod pa ya mtshan pa dag kyang ston par mdzad de/ rtse le yas mas gnyis su re mos kyis bzhugs nas chos kyi 'gro don mdzad 348)pa'i ngang nas/ dgung lo zhe brgyad par grwa tshang du sku mya ngan las 'das te/ dgongs pa rdzogs byed kyi rim pa rgya cher bsgrubs shing*/ rtse le gong 'og gnyis kar sku tshab kyi snang brnyan bzhengs/ thugs ljags ma nyams par byon pa ni grwa tshang du 'dra sku'i nang du bzhugs par mdzad la/ rje 'di sngar nas yang yang du/ bdag gi ro khog 'di bsam yas mchims phu nags kyi dur khrod du 'khyol ba zhig byung na dga' ba la/ zhes rtag par gsungs yod pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs phyir/ mchims phur yang mchod khang chung ngu zhig ched gtad du bzhengs pa'i rten gtso byang chen rten kyi nang bzhugs su yang gdung rus mang bar bzhugs su gsol/ de nas yang gong gi 'phror/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rje dgung lo so bdun skabs dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi sprul pa'i sku dwags po 'brug mdar kun mkhyen bkra shis rnam rgyal dang rje btsun karma phrin las pa sogs kyi dbon 349) rgyud nang so rgyal po'i sras su sku 'khrungs pa dgung lo lnga par thang 'brog grwa tshang du spyan drangs/ sgra snyan ngag dang rgya bod kyi yig rigs sogs zhabs drung mthu stobs pas gnang zhing*/ gzhan gsan sbyong bka' lung dbang khrid phyag bzhes gdangs dbyangs kyis mtha' brten pa tshun chod rnams mtshungs med de nyid rang gis bum pa gang byor phul/ rje dbang phyug rdo rje'i drung du bsnyen par rdzogs nas/ o rgyan bstan 'dzin phrin las rgya mtsho'i sder mtshan btags/ mi mang spyi pas/ rtse le chos rje sku skye zhes sku yon che ba'i snyan grags thon/ dgung lo bcu drug pa la thang 'brog grwa tshang gi chos kyi khrir mnga' gsol bas/

yig rigs gdangs dbyangs sogs kyis grwa tshang la bka' drin che bar byung*/ grwa tshang gi 'du khang chen mo steng khang dang bcas pa dang nang*/ so thab tshang sogs dang bcas pa'i khang las rnams kyang mtshungs med de nyid dang chos rje 350)'di pa lhan cig pas thugs khur bzhes nas legs par grub/ dgongs 'dus kyi dkyil chog chen mo'i chog grwa tshugs shing*/ rtse le gong nas rig 'dzin yab sras bzhugs dus kyi dbu mdzad bgres po ngag dbang bstan 'dzin grwa tshang du gdan drangs te/ bka' brgyad gsang ba yongs rdzogs dang*/ bla ma gsang 'dus kyi cho ga gdangs dbyangs phyag len dang bcas pa gu ru chos dbang nas brgyud pa'i srol rgyun ma nyams pa 'dzug par mdzad cing*/ chos bka' de dag gi dbang lung sgrub pa chen mo bdud rtsi sman sgrub dang sbrags pa yang mtshugs med nyid kyis shin tu zhib rgyas nan chags par gnang bas grwa tshogs 'dus pa mtha' dag smin grol gyi skal ba can du mdzad do/ ༈ mtshungs med rin po che dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe lnga par gtsang po mgo dgu'i sgrub sde gtsugs pa yin te/ gnas de ni sngon rje rang byung rdo rje dang*/ chos rgyal rin chen gling pa sogs skyes chen grub thob 351)mang pos gnas sgo phyes shing zhabs kyi bcags pa yin kyang*/ rgya gar gyi dur khrod pad+ma brtsegs pa'i cha lag yin pa'i gshis kyis ha cang sa gnyan zhing mi ma yin gyi 'du tshogs che bas/ su yang gis ma chags shing*/ grong pa'i sems can stor ba tsam phyir phyugs rdzi sogs re gnyis kyi phyin na'ang mthong snang cho 'phrul 'jigs skrag cher yod pa zhig yin pa/ dus phyis chos rje rdzogs chen pa bsod nams rin chen de nyid kyis bzhugs shing sku mya ngan las 'da' sa yang der mdzad de/ sa de'i lte bar sku gdung bzhus pa nas sa gzhi dul bar gyur/ de rjes khams kaḥthog pa bla ma shākya rgyal mtshan zhes/ rig 'dzin pad+ma gling pa dang zhig po gling pa sogs mang po'i zhal slob yin pa'i nus mthu byin rlabs can zhig gis phyogs der byon nas dang por rtel rtsa ri khrod zhes par bzhugs shing*/

slar lo gsum song rjes 352)gtsang po mgo dgu'i gnas su byon nas/ grong gsar ba'i yon bdag tshe dbang dar rgyas zhes pas zhing dang ther chen sogs phul ba la rten gzhi byas nas mtsho rdzong nor bu ri'i steng du bla brang lte ba thog gcig ma de btab nas bzhugs pas/ grwa pa pho mo kha yar 'dus pa rnams cog bu dang brag phug la brten sa yod pa/ smon lam dang rten 'brel shugs kyis khong yon mchod mthun par mtshungs med nyid spyan drangs nas dgon mchod gzhis yo byad gang yod dang bcas pa rtsis phul/ de 'phral du grwa pa sdom ldan kha cig ma gtogs rtogs ldan cha byad dang btsun ma'i rigs mtha' dag bton zhing rab byung sha stag gi sgrub grwa btsugs nas/ cho ga chos spyod dang phyag bzhes gdangs dbyangs sogs dang*/ tha na na bza' dbu zhwa tshun chod thang 'brog grwa tshang nyid ji lta ba ma gtogs/ sgrub sder bsnyad btags pa'i mgo 353)sog 'gab rdum khyi thul sogs kyi cha lugs dang*/ chos rgyud 'di yin med pa'i gang snyam dang*/ pho mo 'dres ma'i rigs sogs lar nas byed pa med par mdo sngags zung 'jug gi chos khrims bsdam shing*/ 'di nas bzung ste mtshungs med de nyid kyang grwa tshang du skabs 'gar bka' chos sogs gnang bar phebs pa tsam las/ rgyun bzhugs ni sgrub sde 'di nyid du bzhugs nas chos kyi bdud rtsi lhug stsol du gnang*/ bla brang gzim chung nyi ma lha khang thab tshang dang bcas pa dang*/ spyil bu rnams kyang rim pas grub nas dge 'dun lnga bcu rtsa grangs rnams chos mthun la bkod/ rje de nyid zhal bzhugs pa'i ring la gnyer las 'dzin mtha' dag la bka' stsal te/ spyir rab tu byung bas sha chang bag med du spyod ga nas rung zhing*/ khyad par dgon pa dang dge 'dun 'du ba'i nang so thab sdig byed pa 'di 'dra ni 354)sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rma 'byin chen por 'dug kyang gzhan la ni lab sa mi rnyed/

ngos rang gi dgon chung 'dir thab sdig gtan nas byed pa mi phod do/ gsungs nas sku mgron gal che chung ci 'dra byung na'ang*/ gsol sder du mar thud gang 'dzom dang*/ la phug sgog gtsong sha mo sngo ngad kyi rigs kho na 'dren par byed pas mgron po nyams med phal pa kun ni/ chos rje slob dpon pa'i mgron skyong gi sder kha 'dra ba zhes ha gang dang zhe khrel byed kyang*/ thugs bsam dang chos nyams yod pa thams cad ni ya mtshan dang da mos kyi gnas su byed pa byung yang*/ phyis su rje de nyid zhi bar gshegs shul du bla gnyer bsam chung dag gis sdig rgyun gtsugs snang ba ni dga' rab dbang phyug gi byin rlabs zhugs pa las gzhan ma yin no// ༈ de nas yang rje de nyid dgung lo zhe bdun pa'i thog tu long po bde chen dgon gyi grwa tshang 'jug par mdzad pa yin te/ de ni sngon g.yu sgra'i rnam sprul gter ston bsam gtan bde chen gling pas dgon pa 'debs pa'i sa yul gzigs pas/ sa cha de rdzong gi dbyibs lta bu zhing skyong gi pho brang yin par gzigs nas 'debs 355)par mdzad cing*/ ming pad+ma chos gling du btags par mdzad kyang*/ mi mang rnams kyi bde chen gling pa'i dgon pa yin phyir/ bde chen dgon du rang shugs kyis grags la/ rim pas ser khyim dang grong nag tu gyur na'ang*/ grwa tshang 'di'i bla ma'i thog ma mkhyen rab rnam rgyal sogs 'khrungs pa yin pa'i stabs kyis/ khong gi dbon rgyud sogs sa cha'i bdag po rnams bgros te mtshungs med 'di nyid chos sde 'degs par gdan drangs shing dgon pa phul ba na/ gtsang dgon sha stag byas chog na ni bdag bzung byed lugs dang*/ khyed tsho mi tshang ches tshe gtsang dgon mi yong na mi dgos gsungs pas gtsang dgon gnang chog par zhus nas sa rgya gnam rgya gang yod phul zhing kho rang rnams kyang mnga' zhabs byed par zhus/ tshul 'di ni ltar snang tsam du khong tshos 'bul tshul ma gtogs/

don du ni zhing 356)skyong chen po nyid kyis phul tshul rje de nyid kyi mnal lam du gsal bar byung snang ngo*/ dgon pa rtsis bzhes phral nas grwa sar nyi shu rtsa gcig 'dus pa'i bla ma don gnyis legs grub pa bkos shing*/ grong pa rnams phyir bton nas lcags ri tshun chad grwa tshang la dbang bar byas te 'du khang bla brang dang bcas pa grub pa nas de phyogs kyi dad zas yong sgo gang byung der sbyar nas bzhag pas mi ring bar dge 'dun bdun cu rtsa grangs tshogs par gyur/ shag skor ni sa khang kyis ma shong tshe/ rgyab kyi ri sgang der spyil bu mang bar 'phel shing dar rgyas che bar byung ba dang*/ don gnyis legs grub pas bla ma lo bco brgyad kyi bar du mdzad de bstan la phan pa shin tu che mus nas/ khong gtsang po mgo dgur mtshungs med kyi rgyal tshab tu bkod cing*/ bde chen dgon du dge slong smin grol dbang po bkos te lo bcu bdun gyi bar du bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs mdzad 357)pa'o/ de ltar mtshungs med kyi dgung lo zhe brgyad pa'i bar du grwa tshang dang chos sde'i thugs khur bzhes shing bla ma ge slong shes rab 'byung gnas zhes pa 'khrungs sa long po gnyags nas yin pa'i/ dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin gyi zhal slob sbyangs yon phun sum tshogs shing grwa tshang thog mar gtsugs skabs chos khrims par bkas gnang ba de nyid phyis mtshungs med nyid kyi dpung rogs dang chos sde slob chung lta bur mdzad nas/ grwa gsar thams cad kyi klog dang tshig slob pa/ de las drag pa'i blo gsar dag la mdzod bdun skor dang rgyud gsang snying gzhung 'grel/ dgongs 'dus kyi rtsa rgyud gzhung 'grel/ sdom gsum 'od 'phreng dang*/ dam tshig rdo rje gsal bkra sogs rgyud gzhung gi 'chad nyan gtong dgos thams cad kyi slob dpon mdzad/ dbang lung nyams khrid sogs zhu ba rnams la mtshungs med nyid kyis gang dgos su stsal

358)ba dang*/ so thar gyi sdom pa gnang dgos kun la yang*/ mtshungs med chen pos mkhan po dang*/ bla ma sher 'byung bas slob dpon mdzad pa sogs bla ma de yang grwa tshang 'di la sku drin shin tu che ba yin zhing*/ tha na grwa gsar btsun chung 'khos med dbul ba'i rigs rnams kyi gdan dang dug hrul lhan tshem tshun chad bla ma dge slong nyid kyis mdzad pa la/ 'ga' zhig gis/ nyid slob dpon chen po zhig gis yon tan slob pa gcig pus chog pa la/ gdan dug thams cad tshags nas ci mdzad zhus tshe/ snyom chung grwa rigs skyong ba la sgo du ma nas ma skyangs na rang che 'gying byas nas bsdad pas grwa tshang mi 'khyongs/ tha na dud 'gro thams cad phru gu gso lugs ga 'dra byed 'dug ltos dang*/ khyad par theg pa chen po'i chos sgor zhugs nas nyams chung la brtse ba che dgos pa yin/ skyes bu dam pa khur lci 359)'khur ba dag /nyam nga'i gnas su nam yang 'dor mi byed/ ces gsungs pa ma thos sam/ zhes gsungs par mdzad pa'i bla ma dge slong sher 'byung ba de nyid dang mtshungs med lhan cig pas grwa tshang skyong bar mdzad la/ mtshungs med dgung lo zhe brgyad pa/ o rgyan bstan 'dzin pa'i sprul sku dgung lo bcu drug par grwa tshang thams cad khong la rtsis sprod par mdzad de/ nyid gtsang po mgo dgur sgrub pa la bzhugs shing*/ bla ma dge slong sher 'byung yang thang 'brog ri khrod du bla brang zhig gsos mdzad nas dgung lo bdun cu rtsa grangs bar du bzhugs pa dang*/ de la brten nas grwa tshang gi bgres rim phal cher yang thang 'brog tu sku mtshams la bzhugs pas ri dgon gnyis ka dar rgyas su gyur/ bla ma sher 'byung ba zhi bar gshegs shul du/ dbu mdzad mdo rgyud bstan 'dzin pa thang 'brog 360)gi bla mar bkod nas sku tshe 'di gar 'khyol bar mdzad do/ mtshungs med de nyid sgrub sde byon nas chos rje sku skye'i drung grwa tshang gi gtsug rgyan du bzhugs pa'i skabs de dag tu bdud rigs kyi skye bo dag gis 'phrul thabs la brten nas mi dpon gyi rigs mang po zhig gis grwa tshang gi chos gzhis la 'phrog rtsod lab gzhi sna tshogs pa byung na'ang*/

de dag la lar ni zhu gsol bden tshig 'bul nod sogs kyis grol zhing*/ la la dag la gzhan gang gis kyang ma 'thus tshe mngon spyod drag po'i las sbyor gyis tshar bcad de rang dbang med par bab bshags zhu btugs skyabs gsol gus 'dud kyi gnas la 'khod par gyur na'ang*/ mi sde spyi pas rtse le ba zhes chos mthongs dang dad zas phul ba'i gnas su byas pa la brten/ dkar srid pa dag gi thugs dgongs la 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma dkar 361)pos klu steng du dgon pa btab pa'i skabs 'dra zhig 'ong dogs pa'i thugs snang shar nas/ chu mdo bas sna 'dren dang*/ rtse lha sgang nas rgyab skyor mdzad de grwa tshang la nyes med kyi kha yog dang bka' bkyon gcig ma sangs par gcig bsnon pa lta bus ci byed kyang ma bde ba dang*/ grwa tshang yang phyogs nas 'khyar po gsar sleb du song gshis kyis/ ngang pa'i dkyil du chu skyar sleb pa'i dpe bzhin du gyur te dgon pa mi chags la khad pa'i skabs der dkon mchog dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong ra mdar sbran pa las gzhan pa'i thabs kyis dben pa na/ spu bo ka gnam sde pa sogs kyis/ khyed dpon slob de phyogs su bzhugs stabs mi bde ba byung na 'di phyogs su phebs pas chog cing*/ dgon pa dang mchod gzhis sogs bdag rkyen gang dgos nged kyi byed pa yin zhes zhu ba byung ba la/ kong stod zing 362)po'i sde pa khag gsum dang*/ gsum mkhar dpon tshang gong 'og gnyis dang bcas pa rnams kyis ni mtshungs med pa'i snyan du zhu nan chen pos/ deng sang khyed kyi grwa tshang la thugs bsun dang 'o brgyal de 'dra yod pa yin na/ chos phyogs ngos nas ci 'dra mdzad rgyu yin pa khyed rang dpon slob mkhas mod la/ 'jig rten ngos nas dmag las g.yul shom ci dang ci lta bu byed dgos byung na'ang nged rnams kyis byed pa yin pas bka' gsal bslab ston mdzod cig ces nan gyis zhus ba la/

mtshungs med de nyid kyi zhal nas/ khyed yon bdag rnams kyis nged kyi bstan pa'i don du sha tsha snying nye de ltar mdzad pa bka' drin che na'ang*/ nged rnams spyir snyom chung dang*/ khyad par chos pa'i khul yin pas dmag las 'khrug rtsod byas nas dgon pa bzung dgos na chos pa'i ming yang mi 'ong ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' 363)las kyang*/ gang du rtsod pa can gyi sa phyogs nas dpag tshad lnga brgya'i pha rol du 'gro bar bya'o/ zhes gsungs phyir/ 'thab rtsod la gnas pa'i dgon sde ni dgos pa ci yang med do/ zhes gsungs par mdzad cing*/ de nas ma 'gyangs par rje yab sras kong phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur ba dang 'grig pas/ rje dbang phyug rdo rje'i drung du rgyu mtshan gnas tshul mtha' dag zhib tu zhus pa na grwa tshang gis gtso byas pa'i dgon gsum por dkar srid sogs kyi bsnyad tshol sun 'byin gyi rigs byed pa med pa'i bka' thams 'dzin yig gnang ba'i sku drin gyis dgon pa chags thub tsam byung ba 'di la/ yang dkar srid la las ni/ sgar chen gyi phyag mdzod dbon po kha ba de 'khrungs sa rnying ma yin pa'i stabs kyis rnying zhen byas pa red ces lkog lab byed pa yang byung ngo*/ zhabs drung karma mthu stobs 364)rnam rgyal gyi sku skye ba rjes ma ni 'brug pa thams cad mkhyen pa pad dkar ba'i gnyer pa zhig gi sras su bya yul gyi zhed gzhis kar me stag la 'khrungs pa dgu lo bcu gsum par grwa tshang du gdan drangs nas/ mtshungs med nyid dang chos rje sku skye drung gnyis ka'i zhabs pad bsten zhing*/ rje dbang phyug rdo rje las dge tshul dang*/ phyis su dpal gtsug lag rgya mtsho las bsnyen par rdzogs te/ karma rig 'dzin mchog grub rnam rgyal du mtshan gsol gnang*/ de ltar mtshungs med bstan 'dzin rdo rje dpal bzang po de nyid kyis bstan pa'i don du dka' las sna tshogs pa la snying stobs dang bzod brtson rmad du byung ba'i khur bsnams te mtha' khob kyi phyogs 'dir snga 'gyur mdo sngags zung 'jug gi bstan pa legs par tshugs shing*/

bla ma gong ma'i rnam par 'phrul pa gnyis ka spyan drangs nas ji ltar 'jig rten na pha bzang pos 365)bu gces pa 'bogs pa lta bur phrin las rnam par dkar ba'i rgyal thabs chos kyi khri la yang dag par mnga' gsol grwa slob 'dus pa mchog dman bar ma kun la yang rnam par grol ba'i lam 'chugs med bde blag tu bstan pa sogs/ mdor na re shig sku tshe de nyid kyi mdzad pa mthar phyin par gzigs nas/ dgongs rdzogs kyi lha khang gi sa 'dul dang rming bting bar grub par mdzad pa'i 'phro rnams mthar 'khyol ba'i zhal bkod sogs zhib rgyas bla ma don gnyis legs grub par gnang ste/ dgung lo don gsum pa shing sbrul sa ga zla ba'i tshes brgyad la gnas chen chu bo g.yas 'khyil gyi mtsho rjong nor bu ri'i rtser sku la bsnyun pa med bzhin dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim tshul bstan tshe/ nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis gang ba dang*/ sprin 'ja' dkar po dpag bsam gyi ljon pa dang*/ dpal be'u la sogs 366)pa'i dbyibs sna tshogs gzims khang gi thog tu rgyun par 'khor/ me tog rigs mtha' dag dus gcig shar ba sogs dang*/ kong por bya rgod mi 'byung mod kyang*/ sku ma thim pa'i zhag gsum gyi gong nas bya rgod thang dkar gzhan las che ba zhig byung nas nyin re bzhin gzims khang gi bar snang la yun ring bskor zhing brag zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtser babs nas sdod pa zhag bdun du byas nas gar song cha med du song*/ gdung bzhu bar grwa tshang nas chos rje sku skye'i drung gdan drangs te dgongs 'dus sbyin sreg phul bas/ gdung rus cher med par me sbur dkar thul 'ba' shig tu gyur cing*/ gdung rus phran bu gang byung thams cad ni rjen log nya phyis kyi kha dog ltar gyur pa de thams cad cung zad kyang ma thor par sats+tsha gdab pa'i cho ga tshul bzhin bgyis nas sku 'bum byang chen mchod rten du bzhugs su gsol ba yin te/

rje nyid kyi zhal 367)chems su/ khyed tshos rmongs zhen gyis nga'i rus pa mchod khang gi rten gyi nang du gtan nas ma bcug cig sa thob pa'i gang zag ma gtogs gzhan ma'i rus pa rten la lar gzhug mi rung*/ rten gyi nang rdzong la sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung dang*/ gtso bor gsang ba ring srel la sogs mdo rgyud kyi gzungs 'bum 'di rnams med du mi rung bar bsngags pa yin pas de tshos chog gi bla gzugs su byung byung gi rus pa dang zag rdzas bcug pa ni gtan mi rung ngo*/ zhes gsungs pa ji lta ba'i dgongs pa bsgrubs te/ mchod khang gi rten rnams byin rlabs dam rdzas 'phel gdung gzungs sngags rnams kyis byur bur bkang zhing rab gnas zhib rgyas dang*/ gzhan yang dgongs pa rdzogs thabs kyi bya ba mtha' dag rgya cher bsgrubs pa yang chos rje sku skye drung dang dgongs pa bstun ngos bla ma don gnyis legs grub pas yongs su rdzogs par 368)grub pa'i mthar rta lor bla ma nyid kyang bsam pa rdzogs pa'i tshul gyis zhi bar gshegs/ de'i sang phod me lug gi lo chu stod zla ba'i nyer brgyad la grwa tshang du chos rje sku skye o rgyan bstan 'dzin phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde yang dgung lo zhe gsum pa'i thog tu/ gdul bya gzhan don la dgongs nas gshegs pas/ mthu stobs pa'i sprul sku rig 'dzin mchog grub rnam rgyal dgung lo bcu bdun pa la grwa tshang gi rnam 'dren du mnga' gsol ba las/ khong nyid sku gong mas gtsug lag rten gsum kun la zhabs tog mdzad tshul stobs ches pa'i mthu byin yin par gleng ba dang mthun pa'i zang zing gdul bya 'du long grwa tshogs sogs ni gang las kyang lhag par 'ar 'ur du byung na'ang*/ sku mtshams thugs dam sogs la brtson pa lhod pa dang*/ chang la mnyes shing 'bar zhwa phu dud kyis mtshon sogs 'dul ba'i kun 369)spyod dang mi mthun pa'i mdzad pa mang bas/ grwa tshang gi btsun gzhon phal cher yang spyod pa de lta dar ba la/

mkha' 'gro chos srung mi dgyes pa'i ltas kyi mnal lam sogs kyang gsal bar byung ba'i mthar/ sman pas brtag tu mi nus pa'i bsnyun gzhi dam pos zin te/ sku rim gsol sman sogs gang gis kyang phan ngo med pa'i khar zas spyod sogs kyi 'dzem cha yang gtan nas ma gnang bas sku khams 'tsho thub pa'i thabs rtsa ba nas zad pa'i tshe yang*/ bdag 'dir bsdad pas ma byung ba yin/ rtse le gong du bsdad na nad 'di yong rgyu min par 'dug pas da rung yang rab la bsam yas mchims phu'am/ de ltar ma byung kyang rtse ler ro khog skyel thub pa dgos gsungs nas/ sus zhus kyang ma gsan par sku chas dang phyag rdzas drag na drag tshad bsnams nas bsnyun 370)bzhin par yar byon/ rtse ler phebs nas sku 'tshe mi thub par dgongs te/ phyag rdzas gtos che rab brdzangs nas lha sa bsam yas la mchod pa 'bul bar phyag phyi dmangs ma rnams btang yang*/ phyag mdzod pa sogs 'grul ma thub pas phyag rdzas phal cher dngos med du zad/ sku nyid sa rta'i lo smin drug gi gnam gang dgung lo nyer dgu pa'i thog tu rtse ler sku thim/ de phral la sngar rtse le'i sprul sku ba grwa tshang 'du khang gi shing tshon gtong bar bos nas/ lo phyed lnga'i ring la las ka mthar phyin byas pa'i yon du rta dang dre'u sogs gnang ba'i zhal bzhes mdzad nas ci yang ma gnang bas/ sku gshegs skabs der sprul sku ba 'khor bcas kyis sngar zhal gyi ji ltar bzhes pa'i rta drel rnams rta ra'i nang nas lag rgyab ste khrid/ de la grwa tshang ba'i phyag phyi rnams kyis tshur 'phrog pas/ rtse le gong ma ba thams cad sprul 371)sku ba'i phyogs byas te gong 'og 'thab 'khon byung zhing*/ sku chas mang ma rnams kyang khong tshos bkag pas sde pa sku rab pas zhal phye gtong dgos pa byung skabs su/ bla ma sku gshegs pas ma chog sku gdung yod thog rang la khyed rtse le gong ma rnams kyi byed lugs ma mkhas par byung 'dug gsungs nas/

'og gi sku chas thams cad grwa tshang ba rnams la sprad cing*/ sprul sku bar yang yon gyi rnam pa phran bu byin/ sku skye ngos 'dzin gyi sku chas rags bsdus phyag sgam cig la grwa tshang gong 'og gnyis sde pa rang dang gsum ga'i rtags 'byar byas nas/ sprul pa'i sku yas mas gang du byon byung kyang mchod yon gsum ga 'dzom dgos pa'i phyag thams bzhag par mdzad rung*/ sprul sku byar smad jo bo bzhugs sa dang nye bar lcags sprel la 'khrungs kyang*/ de skabs sde pa 'pho 'chugs song tshar bas/ rtse 372)le gong ma rnams kyis grwa tshang la skad ma btang bar sprul sku khong rang tshos thob par bya'o bsam nas sku chas sgam gyi rgya bshig cing sprul sku gsang thabs su gdan drangs pa la 'og ma'i grwa rigs rnams ni mi gshis gyong bas/ nam kyang 'khon gzhi'i rgyu las mi yong bar bsam ste btang snyoms su bsgyur/ sprul pa'i sku'i skra phud ni sgam por rje nor bu brgyan pa'i drung du phul na'ang*/ rang bzhin bdag rkyen ni de skabs dwags lung pa yang ri bas bzung dus yin pa'i stabs kyis yang rir bdag rkyen zhus 'dug pa dang*/ yang ri bas dbang lung dang gsan sbyong sogs kyi slob dpon sbyor gtod chos rje karma gu ru ba'i sku skye'i drung du gnang zhing*/ sprul pa'i sku nyid thugs rab rnam dpyod kyi dpal du 'bar yang*/ chos rje gung ru ba dpon slob 'du long che zhing sku tshe thung bas gsan pa mthar phyin mdzad long ma byung bar 373)snang ngo*/ bdag lho brag tu bsnyen rdzogs zhu bar phyin pa'i lam zhor phan tshun gnyis kar rtse ler phyin pa na/ khong rnams kyis bdag rkyen mthong bkur shin tu bzang bar mdzad byung zhing*/ sprul pa'i sku dgung lo dgu pa'i skabs su 'dug pa la brtan bzhugs dang*/ tshe sgrub rdor 'phreng dkon mchog spyi 'dus sogs chos bka' yang phul/ dpon slob kun dang thugs yid 'dres bar byung ba dang*/

phyis sor yang bka' shog dang zhu lan gyi 'brel brgyud 'ga' yang byung ba nas/ rang ngos nas gong 'og 'brel ma chad cing thugs mthun pa zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa zhes thag pa nas yod na'ang*/ thog mar grwa tshang gtsugs dus nas dam sel gyi rnam pa byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi skyon zhig yin pa 'dra ste/ nam du'ang yas mas gnyis mi rigs gros rigs mi mthun pa'i ngang la 374)song nas sprul pa'i sku grwa tshang du phebs pa sogs kyi 'brel zab zhig da bar du ma byung ngo*/ ༈ dpal o rgyan bstan 'dzin pa'i sku skye chos rje phrin las rgya mtsho'i sde dgung lo zhe gsum pa me lug pa la mya ngan las 'das nas sa mo bya la long po rtse dkar du sde pa tshe ring dbang po'i bur 'khrungs pa dgung lo bzhi lon nas sku gshegs te/ slar yang long po bcas sder sngags 'chang bkra shis tshe brtan pa la bu mo lnga yod kyang bu med pas dgongs 'dus las tshogs nas gsungs pa'i srid 'bebs kyi gdams ngag gi thabs rten 'brel byas pa la brten nas sprul pa'i sku de nyid shing stag la 'khrungs/ gsung bye ma thag tu sku gong ma'i bag chags dran pa'i bka' gsal mang du gnang ba na/ yab thugs bsam chung nas khong rang la bu med pa'i 'dod gdungs kyi/ rdzas ngan grib can mang 375)po mgul du btags pa nas ljags dang thugs rig cung zad mi gsal du song*/ 'on kyang dus bzang sogs la ngo mtshar ba'i gsung mang du byin zhing*/ kar phu dbon po dang gang 'dod sgrub chen ma sogs de phyogs kyi gsal snang dang mngon shes can dag gis kyang skyes bu dam par lung bstan pa la brten/ bde chen dgon nas slob dpon rin po che dam chos bas brdzu thabs kyi sgo nas brtag pa la byon pas ngos 'dzin yid ches nges 'drongs 'byung ba dang*/ thams cad mkhyen pa nor bu brgyan pa dang*/ gter ston 'ja' tshon snying po la thugs dam gyi brtag pa zhus pas legs so'i bka' stsal byung ba sogs la yid gtan du bgyis te dgung lo bcu gcig pa shing byi la grwa tshang du spyan drangs skabs legs tshogs kyi rten 'brel la dmigs nas bsu ba'i bye brag dang che 'don gyi bkod bshom kho na yang 'khos la dpags pa'i mthong thos kun yid ches thub pa tsam
